translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Jesucristupa chaquinman perfümita María winapashgan
Pascuapä sogta junag pishiycaptinmi Jesús aywargan Betania marcaman. Saychömi wanushganpita cawarisimushgan Lázaro targan.

Sayman Jesús chashganpita cushicurmi Läzarupa panincuna merendata yanucuyargan paywan micuyänanpä. Waquin runacunawan mësa cagman Jesús jamacuptinmi Läzarupis jamargan paycunawan micunanpä. Saymanmi panin Marta paycunata garargan.
Saycho micuycäyaptinmi botëllawan María apamorgan nardu jachapita rurash chanin cuestag perfümita. Nircurmi Jesuspa chaquinman winaparcur agsanwan saquisipargan.
Say perfümimi wayi junta mushcorgan.
Saymi Jesusta entregananpä cag discïpulun Judas Iscariote nergan:
“¿Imanirtä cay perfümita perdiycäsin? Saypa trucanga ranticushwan cargan juc wata arupacur gänashgansichöno. Nircur say guellaywanna muchogcunata yanapashwan cargan.”
Judasmi shuntayashgan guellay sararag cargan. Sayno nergan manami muchogcunata yanapayta munarsu, sinöga quiquinpä guellayta raquinan cashmi.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Winapämashganpita ama jamuraysu. Say perfümitaga churaräsish manarä wanuptë winapämänanpämi.
Muchogcunaga yanapäyänayquipä imaypis caycäyangami. Nogami isanga gamcunawan cashäpänasu.”
Läzarutapis wanusiyta munayashgan
Betania marcacho Jesús caycashganta musyarmi asca runacuna sayman aywayargan. Manami Jesusta ricaglasu aywayargan, sinöga Lázaro cawarimushganta ricayänanpäwanmi aywayargan.
Läzaruta cawarisimushganpita Jesusman asca runacuna criyiptinmi mandag cüracuna Läzarutapis wanusiyta munayargan.
Jerusalenman Jesucristo yaycuptin runacuna alabayashgan
Waraynin tuta runacuna musyayargan Jerusalenman Jesús aywaycashganta. Saymi Pascuaman aywag asca runacuna, palmacunata muturcur, apayargan Jesusta chasquicuyänanpä.
Jesús chaptinna niyargan: “¡Tayta Diosninsi cachamushgan mandamagninsi caychönami caycan! ¡Paymi mandamagninsi rey caycan!”
Tayta Diosninsipa palabrancho guelgaraycashgannölami manarä amansashga orgu ashnun muntash Jerusalenman Jesús chargan. Say guelgaraycashganga caynömi nican:

content.text: ricayay humildi runanöla mandagniqui rey manarä amansashga ashnun muntash shamuycagta.”

content: Jerusalenman ashnun muntash Jesús chaptinmi discïpuluncuna tantyayargansu imanir sayno ruraycashgantapis. Wanushganpita cawarircamuptinrämi tantyayargan Jesús rurashgancuna Tayta Diospa palabrancho nishgannöla caycashganta.

Läzaruta cawarisimushganta musyashpanmi asca runacuna cushish Jesusta taripag shayämorgan. Pay cawarisimushganta ricag runacunapis Tayta Diosta alabaraycar aywaycäyargan. Nänipa aywayashpanmi pï-maytapis tincushgan cagta wilapäyargan Läzaruta cawarisimushganta.
Jesusman asca runacuna criyiyashganta ricarmi fariseo runacuna niyargan: “Cananga ¿imatatä rurashun? ¡Lapan runacunami payman criyiycäyan!”
Mana Israel runacuna Jesucristuwan parlayta munayashgan
Pascua captinmi may-say nacioncunapitapis Jerusalenman aywayargan mana Israel runacunapis.
Paycunapita waquin runacunami Felipita ruwacuyargan: “Jesusta reguiycasiyälämay, taytay” nir. (Felipega cargan Galilea provinciacho Betsaida marcapitami.)
Sayno manacuyaptinmi Felipe aywaycur Andresta wilargan. Nircurnami ishcan aywaycur Jesusta wilayargan mana Israel runacuna paywan tincuyta munaycäyashganta.
Wilayaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Noga wanunäpä cag höra chaycämunnami.

Shumag tantyacuyay. Musyashgansinöpis trïguta murur mana pampashgaga manami winamunsu. Pampashgami isanga winamur ali wayun. Saynölami noga mana wanuptë pipis salvacongasu. Wanuptëmi isanga asca runacuna salvacuyangapä.
“Tayta Diosta cäsucunanpa trucan quiquin munashganno cawacuyta munagcunaga manami pipis gloriaman chäyangasu. Tayta Dios munashganno cawag cagcunami isanga gloriaman char imayyagpis cawayangapä.
Mayganpis discïpulö cayta munag cäga noga cawashgäno cawasun. Imano nacarpis mana ajayaypa gatiräyämäsun. Sayno gatirämagcunataga Taytä cushishgami chasquengapä.
Wanunanpä cashganta Jesucristo wilacushgan
“Fiyupa laquicuymi sarimash. Sayno laquish caycarpis manami Taytäta manacömansu wanuypita sapämänanpä. Sayno wanunäpämi cay pasaman shamushcä.”

Sayno nishpanmi Tayta Diosta manacorgan: “Munayyog cashgayquita runacuna tantyacuyänanpä gam munashgayquino lapanpis cayculäsun, papá.” Sayno manacuptinmi ciëlupita Tayta Dios nimorgan: “Manacamashgayquita imaypis rurashgänölami cananpis rurashä.”
Sayta wiyarmi saycho cag waquin runacuna: “¡Magacuymi cash!” niyargan. Waquinnami: “¡Angilmi parlamush!” niyargan.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Manami gamcuna niyashgayquinösu caycan. Tayta Diosmi sayno parlamush nogaman yäracayämänayquipä.
Runacunata Tayta Diosninsi juzgananpä cag höra chaycämunnami. Saynömi runacunata munaynincho sararag diablupis vincish cananpä höran chämongana.
Saymi crucificamashganpita cawarircamur Israel runacunata y mana Israel runacunatapis tantyasishä nogaman yäracayämänanpä.”
Sayno nirmi Jesús tantyasergan crucificaypa wanusish cananpä cashganta.

Saymi runacuna niyargan: “Tayta Diosninsipa palabranchöga nican salvamagninsi Cristo imayyagpis cawananpä cashgantami. Sayno nicaptenga ¿imanirtä nicanqui wanunayquipä cashganta? Sayno captenga ¿rasunpacu Cristo caycanqui?”

Sayno niyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Au, Tayta Dios cachamashgan Cristumi caycä. Sayno captinpis walca junaglanami gamcunawan cashäpä. Saymi gamcunawan caycashgäyag jusayquicunata cacharir yachasishgäcunata chasquicuyänayqui. Chasquicorga wanusimaptinpis Tayta Diospa naupanman chäyanquipä. Jusayquicunata mana cacharerga manami imanöpapis paypa naupanman chäyanquipäsu.

Sayno caycaptenga yachasishgäcunata chasquicuyay. Saynöpami gamcunapis Tayta Diospa wamrancuna cayanquipä.” Sayno nircurmi Jesús aywacorgan. Sayno aywacuptinnami runacuna musyayargansu maypa aywacushgantapis.
Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta runacuna mana criyiyashgan
Asca milagrucunata Jesús ruraycashganta ricarpis runacuna manami criyiyargansu Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta.
Sayno mana criyiyänanpä cashganpitami Tayta Diosninsipa profëtan Isaías unay cayno guelgargan:

content.text: “Tayta Dios, wilacuyniquita wilacuptëpis runacuna manami chasquicuyansu.

content: Mastapis paycunapä Isaías caynömi guelgargan:

content.text: “Tayta Diosmi yarpayninta upatacäsergan wilacuyninta mana tantyayänanpä.
Saynömi shonguntapis chucruyäsergan payman mana yäracuyänanpä.
Saymi payta chasquicuyansu jusalicuyashganpita perdonash cayänanpä.”

content: Isaías sayno guelgargan runacuna Jesusta mana chasquicuyänanpä cashganta musyarmi. Paytami Tayta Diosninsi ricasergan Jesucristo gloriacho munayyog caycagta.

Jesucristuta waquin Israel runacuna mana chasquicuyaptinpis waquin cag Israel runacunami isanga criyiyargan Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta. Saynölami Israel autoridäcunapis waquenga criyiyargan Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta. Sayno criyiycarpis sinagogapita fariseo autoridäcuna gargunanta mansacuyashpanmi Jesusman yäracuyashganta wilacuyargansu.
Tayta Diospita ali ricash cayänanpa trucanga paycunaga más munayargan runacunalapita ali ricash caytami.
Jesucristuta chasquicogcuna Tayta Diostapis chasquishgan
Saypitana fuertipa Jesús nergan: “Nogata chasquicamag cäga cachamagnë Taytätapis chasquicuycanmi.
Saynöpis nogata reguimag cäga cachamagnë Taytätapis reguiycanmi.
Chasquicamagcuna Tayta Diosta reguir sacäpacushno mana cayänanpämi cay pasaman shamushcä. Saymi runacunapä noga acsino caycä.

“Manami runacunata juzganäpäsu cay pasaman shamushcä, sinöga jusancunata perdonar salvanäpämi. Sayno captinpis nishgäcunata mana cäsucamagcunaga manami perdonashgasu cayanga, sinöga juicio finalcho infiernuman gaycushmi cayangapä.
“Manami quiquiläpa yarpayläpitasu wilacuycä, sinöga Taytä nimashgancunalatami wilacuycä. Paymi imata wilacunäpäpis tantyasimash.
Sayno wilacuptëmi runacuna chasquicur gloriaman chäyangapä. Saymi Taytä nimashgannöla imaypis wilacuycä.”

footnotes.text: Say wisanmi runacuna pampaman weguycur micuyag. Sayno micuptinmi Jesuspa chaquinta María agsanwan saquisipargan.
-13 Say wisan costumbri cashganno marcaman juc rey yaycuptin runacuna cushish chasquicorga jacuncunata, punchuncunata y palmatapis näniman mashtapäyag.
Isaías gloriacho ricashgancunata musyanayquipä liyinqui Isaías 6-ta.
